en.hook: Shadow AI: Mitigating Hidden Data Risks with Data Engineering Governance
en.body: Shadow AI—unauthorized AI tools used by employees—create hidden data risks. Learn how data engineering governance with tools like dbt and Great Expectations can secure AI adoption and improve data quality.
